Duplicate or older versions are ignored idempotently; if an older version (such as `v1`) arrives after a newer version, any missing static metadata (`reference`, `debit_party`, `credit_party`) is backfilled without regressing `version`, `status`, or `clearing_stage`.\n- Deletes the Valkey key `clearledger:settlement:<settlement_id>`.\n- If any record fails validation or deserialization, its `messageId` is returned in `batchItemFailures` so SQS retries only the failed message and routes poison messages to the DLQ after `maxReceiveCount = 4` receives.\n\n## 3. Outbox Relay Worker (`relay_image` on AWS Lambda)\n\n- **Bootstrap**: `/var/runtime/bootstrap`\n- **Trigger**: EventBridge Scheduler every 1 minute (`rate(1 minute)`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: `\"http://aws:4566\"`\n  - `DATABASE_URL`: `postgres://<db_username>:<db_password>@<rds_host>:<rds_port>/<db_name>`\n  - `SQS_QUEUE_URL`: URL of the main SQS event queue\n  - `OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE`: `\"50\"` (must be explicitly set to `\"50\"`)\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the relay CloudWatch Log Group\n\nQueries up to `OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE` rows from `clearledger.outbox` where `published_at IS NULL` ordered by `seq ASC`, sends each event envelope to `SQS_QUEUE_URL`, and updates `published_at = NOW(), attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = NULL`.\n\n## 4. Audit Archiver Worker (`archiver_image` on AWS Lambda)\n\n- **Bootstrap**: `/var/runtime/bootstrap`\n- **Trigger**: EventBridge Scheduler every 5 minutes (`rate(5 minutes)`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: `\"http://aws:4566\"`\n  - `DATABASE_URL`: `postgres://<db_username>:<db_password>@<rds_host>:<rds_port>/<db_name>`\n  - `AUDIT_BUCKET`: name of the S3 audit archive bucket\n  - `AUDIT_PREFIX`: `\"ledger-audit/\"` (must be explicitly set to `\"ledger-audit/\"`)\n  - `AUDIT_BATCH_SIZE` (optional): defaults to `100`\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the archiver CloudWatch Log Group\n\nSelects published outbox rows (`published_at IS NOT NULL AND archived_at IS NULL`) ordered by `seq ASC`, writes a newline-delimited JSON object to `s3://<AUDIT_BUCKET>/ledger-audit/batch-<first_seq:08d>-<last_seq:08d>-<16_char_sha256_hex>.ndjson`, and sets `archived_at = NOW()`.\n\n## 5. Scopes are strictly non-hierarchical:\n\n- `clearledger/read`: permitted only on `GET /v1/settlements/{id}` and `GET /v1/settlements/{id}/ledger`.\n- `clearledger/write`: permitted only on `POST /v1/settlements` and `POST /v1/settlements/{id}/entries`.\n- `clearledger/admin`: permitted only on `POST /v1/admin/projections/{id}/rebuild`.\n\nMissing or invalid tokens return `401 Unauthorized`; valid tokens lacking the exact endpoint scope return `403 Forbidden`.\n\n## 6. '/workspace/config/config.json')).read_text())\n+P = C['resource_prefix']\n+if P.startswith('cl-base-') or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9-]{3,23}', P):\n+    raise ValueError('Invalid or baseline **kwargs):\n+    try:\n+        return call(**kwargs)\n+    except ClientError as e:\n+        if e.response['Error']['Code'] in ('NoSuchEntity', 'NoSuchEntityException', 'ResourceNotFoundException',\n+                'ResourceNotFound', 'DBInstanceNotFound', 'DBInstanceNotFoundFault', 'NoSuchBucket',\n+                'AWS.SimpleQueueService.NonExistentQueue', 'ClearLedgerDeployment'), None)\n+    return not str(name).startswith('cl-base-') and (str(name).startswith(P + '-') or tag == P)\n+\n+\n+def manifest(path=None):\n+    m = json.loads(Path(path or != P:\n+        raise ValueError('Manifest belongs to a different deployment')\n+    return m\n+\n+\n+def db(m):\n+    d = m['database']\n+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 90\n+    while True:\n+        try:\n+            return psycopg.connect(host=d['endpoint'], port=d['port'], dbname=C['db_name'],\n+                user=C['db_username'], password=C['db_password'], connect_timeout=5, iam.delete_instance_profile(InstanceProfileName=profile['InstanceProfileName'])\n+    for pol in list(pages('iam', 'list_policies', 'Policies', Scope='Local')):\n+        tags = entities = iam.list_entities_for_policy(PolicyArn=pol['Arn'])\n+        if not any(entities.get(k) for k in ('PolicyRoles', 'PolicyUsers', 'PolicyGroups')):\n+            remove_policy(pol['Arn'])\n+\n+\n+def kms_owned():\n+    kms = client('kms')\n+    for k in pages('kms', 'list_keys', 'Keys'):\n+        desc = kms.describe_key(KeyId=k['KeyId'])['KeyMetadata']\n+        tags = kms.list_resource_tags(KeyId=k['KeyId']).get('Tags', [])\n+        tags = [{'Key': t['TagKey'], 'Value': t['TagValue']} for t in tags]\n+        if scoped(desc.get('Description', ''), kms.cancel_key_deletion(KeyId=k['KeyId'])\n+            kms.enable_key(KeyId=k['KeyId'])\n+        elif k['KeyState'] == 'Disabled':\n+            kms.enable_key(KeyId=k['KeyId'])\n+    print('Operational policy and KMS hygiene complete')\n+\n+\n+def schema():\n+    with db(manifest()) as conn:\n+        conn.execute((ROOT / 'schema.sql').read_text())\n+    print('PostgreSQL schema, constraints, triggers, and indexes repaired')\n+\n+\n+def schedule_state(name, state):\n+    s = client('scheduler')\n+    old = s.get_schedule(Name=name)\n+    allowed = ('Name', 'GroupName', 'ScheduleExpression', 'ScheduleExpressionTimezone', 'StartDate', 'EndDate',\n+        'Description', 'FlexibleTimeWindow', 'Target', 'KmsKeyArn', 'ActionAfterCompletion')\n+    args = {k: old[k] for k l.update_event_source_mapping(UUID=uuid, Enabled=enabled)\n+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 60\n+    while True:\n+        state = l.get_event_source_mapping(UUID=uuid)['State']\n+        if state time.sleep(1)\n+\n+\n+def invoke(name, payload):\n+    result = client('lambda').invoke(FunctionName=name, InvocationType='RequestResponse', Payload=json.dumps(payload).encode())\n+    body = result['Payload'].read()\n+    if result.get('FunctionError'):\n+        raise RuntimeError('Worker invocation failed: ' + body.decode()[:512])\n+    return json.loads(body or b'{}')\n+\n+\n+def ddb_scan(table):\n+    return list(pages('dynamodb', 'scan', 'Items', TableName=table, ConsistentRead=True))\n+\n+\n+def batch_write(table, requests):\n+    d = client('dynamodb')\n+    for start in     yield from [('version', v) for v in page.get('Versions', [])]\n+        yield from [('marker', v) for v in page.get('DeleteMarkers', [])]\n+\n+\n+def delete_versions(bucket, objects):\n+    s3 = Finally restores normal worker operation.\n+    try:\n+        for s in schedules:\n+            schedule_state(s, 'DISABLED')\n+        mapping_state(uuid, False)\n+        time.sleep(4)  # Allow the bounded (3s) in-flight worker invocations to finish.\n+        with db(m) as conn:\n+            conn.execute('SET LOCAL lock_timeout = \\'60s\\'')\n+            conn.execute('LOCK TABLE clearledger.settlements, clearledger.events, clearledger.outbox, clearledger.idempotency_keys IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE')\n+            events = conn.execute('SELECT payload FROM clearledger.events ORDER BY settlement_id, aggregate_version').fetchall()\n+            settlements = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM clearledger.settlements ORDER BY settlement_id').fetchall()\n+            outbox = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM clearledger.outbox ORDER BY seq').fetchall()\n+            #            match = re.fullmatch(r'ledger-audit/batch-(\\d{8})-(\\d{8})-([0-9a-f]{16})\\.ndjson', key)\n+                valid = kind == 'version' and v.get('IsLatest', False) and match is not None\n+                      decoded = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines()]\n+                        valid = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()[:16] == match[3] and decoded == [by_seq[i]['payload'] covered.update(range(first, last + 1))\n+                else:\n+                    purge.append({'Key': key, 'VersionId': v['VersionId']})\n+            delete_versions(bucket, purge)\n+            missing = [r for r in outbox if r['seq'] not in covered]\n+            batches = []\n+            for r in missing:\n+                if not batches or len(batches[-1]) == 100 or
